rationale: This mutation eliminates the $9,083 cash deficit by replacing the restrictive daytime reinvestment payroll buffer with an aggressive daytime threshold (0.5x payroll + $40 before hour 18), enabling synchronized expansion to 8-10 plots by Day 6 and 15-16 contiguous plots by Day 11-12 to unlock 5-8 hyper-fertilized Strawberry flushes. It activates rapid early cash velocity by lowering liquidation batch sizes to >=2 surplus on Days 1-5, protects recurring berry acreage by restricting Town Shop seed purchases to uncultivated vacant plots under strict duration feasibility (day + crop_growth_days <= 28; no slow crops after Day 17), and integrates pre-seeding hyper-fertilization directly into in-situ harvest-and-water micro-dispatch with guaranteed Day 30 shed clearance.
